current_prompt_sections.agent task: You are a UML activity diagram code generation agent. Your task is to convert natural-language software requirements into PlantUML code for UML activity diagrams.
current_prompt_sections.input: The input is a single textual software requirement or scenario description.

error_patterns.name: hallucinated_detail_inflation
error_patterns.problem: The prediction injects fabricated activities, validations, and error-handling branches not stated in the requirements, leading to extra activities and extra relations.
possible_causes: The prompt may lack constraints against inventing implicit steps or assuming standard CRUD/error-handling flows.
The model defaults to a 'helpful' implementation mindset, fleshing out plausible but unspecified operational details.

error_patterns.name: parallelism_omission
error_patterns.problem: Concurrent behaviors explicitly modeled with fork/end fork in the ground truth are flattened into sequential steps in the prediction.
possible_causes: The prompt may not sufficiently emphasize identifying and representing concurrent/parallel actions using PlantUML's fork syntax.
The model struggles to recognize linguistic cues for parallelism (e.g., lists of items received simultaneously, concurrent training topics) and defaults to sequential activity flow.

error_patterns.name: over_structuring_simple_requirements
error_patterns.problem: Simple, flat requirements are over-engineered into complex conditional logic, causing missing ground-truth activities, extra activities, and distorted relations.
possible_causes: The prompt may implicitly encourage the use of control-flow structures (if/else, switches) even when a minimal, linear activity flow is more faithful to the text.
Lack of guidance to match the granularity and structural complexity of the source text, leading the model to impose unnecessary decision nodes.

error_patterns.name: lost_conditional_exit_conditions
error_patterns.problem: Explicit exit conditions and state transitions described in the requirements are omitted or merged incorrectly, simplifying the control flow at the expense of accuracy.
possible_causes: The prompt may not instruct the model to carefully extract and preserve all conditional guards and exit criteria as distinct branches.
The model prioritizes creating a single happy-path flow, dropping alternative or terminating conditions that lack explicit 'else' phrasing in the text.

section_diagnoses.section_problem: The rule section is missing, providing no constraints against inventing implicit steps, assuming standard CRUD/error-handling flows, or over-structuring simple requirements with unnecessary conditional logic.

The knowledge section is missing, failing to provide guidance on PlantUML fork syntax for parallelism and reusable modeling patterns for preserving conditional guards and exit criteria as distinct branches.

The workflow section is missing, resulting in no step-by-step process to guide the model in extracting activities faithfully, identifying linguistic cues for concurrent behavior, and matching the granularity of the source text before generating code.
